blocks.value: BLEEDING CONTROL AND FIRST AID RESPONSE
You arrive at the scene of a suspected emergency. Demonstrate what you would do next. Mark each step only if performed correctly.
Note any skills not completed to standard. Learner must receive remediation before certificate is issued.
Verifies scene is safe before approaching
Calls or directs bystander to call EMS
8. Compression Depth (≥2 in / 5 cm) + Full Recoil
Visible chest rise, 1 second per breath
Correct position, arms straight, shoulders above hands
Adequate depth, chest recoil between compressions
Clears all personnel, delivers shock safely
Applies sustained direct pressure with correct technique
Places breathing patient correctly, monitors airway
Provides clear patient status update to arriving EMS
